start.card:
Class A has 10 students. Their average on a test (out of 100 points) is 70.
Class B has 30 students. Their average is 90.
What is the average score of all 40 students together? Type your guess first.
start.title: Two classes, one average

afterGuess.card:
You guessed 5 points. Let's test it.
An "average" is the score everyone would get if all the points were shared out equally.
Move the "Everyone gets" slider. Class B gives away the points above the orange line, and class A fills its gaps up to the line. Find the level where nothing is left over.
afterGuess.title: Two classes, one average

after.card:
At 90: class B gives away 30 × 0 = 0 points. Class A needs 10 × 20 = 200 points.
That is 200 points short, so the level is too high. Move the slider down.
after.title: Two classes, one average
